verdict.rationale: AMD's ROCm docs describe full-stack documentation and recipes for deploying AI workloads with popular ROCm-enabled frameworks, with vLLM and SGLang inference guides. A community benchmark shows MI355X nodes serving a large model in practice. However, the evidence never names PyTorch or shows a compatibility matrix listing MI355X. Missing for 10: explicit PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX build documentation, an official support matrix naming MI355X, independent hands-on confirmation of mainstream training frameworks.
